semiconductor_relevance: High — FUTEC specializes in advanced measurement and inspection equipment for film thickness in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: FUTEC provides high-speed in-situ measurement solutions for film thickness across the entire surface of semiconductor wafers. Their devices are designed for both offline research and development as well as inline integration with film deposition systems, enabling quick detection of abnormalities in film deposition conditions.
capabilities: High-speed film thickness measurement at 300,000 points/sec
In-situ measurement integration with film deposition equipment
Detection of minute defects in film deposition processes
Wafer transport mechanism for comprehensive surface measurement
